scripts.title: Universal ESP
scripts.features:
Simple and clean Universal ESP script built with Rayfield UI.

Features:
- Fixed Bounding Box ESP (accurate sizes)
- Tracers ESP
- Name ESP
- Color Pickers for customization
- Smooth performance & auto-cleanup on player leave
scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "ESP Script",
   LoadingTitle = "ESP Rayfield",
   LoadingSubtitle = "Fixed Boxes",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = false
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("ESP Settings", 4483362458)

local ESP = {
    Boxes = false,
    Tracers = false,
    Names = false,
    BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 136),
    TracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    NameColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function createESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local box = Drawing.new("Square")
    box.Visible = false
    box.Thickness = 1.5
    box.Filled = false

    local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    tracer.Visible = false
    tracer.Thickness = 1

    local name = Drawing.new("Text")
    name.Visible = false
    name.Size = 14
    name.Center = true
    name.Outline = true

    local connection
    connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local character = player.Character
        if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            
    
            local cframe, size = character:GetBoundingBox()
            local hrpPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(cframe.Position)

            if onScreen then
       
                local topPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint((cframe * CFrame.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0)).Position)
                local bottomPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint((cframe * CFrame.new(0, -size.Y / 2, 0)).Position)

                local height = math.abs(topPos.Y - bottomPos.Y)
                local width = height * 0.65

                -- 1. Box ESP
                if ESP.Boxes then
                    box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                    box.Position = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X - width / 2, topPos.Y)
                    box.Color = ESP.BoxColor
                    box.Visible = true
                else
                    box.Visible = false
                end

                -- 2. Tracer ESP
                if ESP.Tracers then
                    tracer.From = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                    tracer.To = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X, bottomPos.Y)
                    tracer.Color = ESP.TracerColor
                    tracer.Visible = true
                else
                    tracer.Visible = false
                end

                -- 3. Name ESP
                if ESP.Names then
                    name.Position = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X, topPos.Y - 16)
                    name.Text = player.DisplayName or player.Name
                    name.Color = ESP.NameColor
                    name.Visible = true
                else
                    name.Visible = false
                end
            else
                box.Visible = false
                tracer.Visible = false
                name.Visible = false
            end
        else
            box.Visible = false
            tracer.Visible = false
            name.Visible = false

            if not Players:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then
                box:Remove()
                tracer:Remove()
                name:Remove()
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
        end
    end)
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    createESP(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(createESP)


Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Boxes",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value) ESP.Boxes = Value end,
})

Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Tracers",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value) ESP.Tracers = Value end,
})

Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Names",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value) ESP.Names = Value end,
})

Tab:CreateColorPicker({
    Name = "Box Color",
    Color = ESP.BoxColor,
    Callback = function(Value) ESP.BoxColor = Value end
})

Tab:CreateColorPicker({
    Name = "Tracer Color",
    Color = ESP.TracerColor,
    Callback = function(Value) ESP.TracerColor = Value end
})

scripts.script:
-- for beginners i made public
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Safe ScreenGui Parent
local function getSafeParent()
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return gethui and gethui() or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end)
    if success and result then
        return result
    end
    return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local ParentContainer = getSafeParent()

-- Cleanup Old Instances
if ParentContainer:FindFirstChild("SpinDashSelectionGui") then
    ParentContainer.SpinDashSelectionGui:Destroy()
end
if ParentContainer:FindFirstChild("SpinDashMainGui") then
    ParentContainer.SpinDashMainGui:Destroy()
end

-- ========================================================
-- 1. DEVICE SELECTION GUI
-- ========================================================
local SelectionGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
SelectionGui.Name = "SpinDashSelectionGui"
SelectionGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
SelectionGui.DisplayOrder = 999999
SelectionGui.Parent = ParentContainer

local Overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
Overlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

end

-- ========================================================
-- 2. MAIN DASH BUTTON GUI
-- ========================================================
local MainGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
MainGui.Name = "SpinDashMainGui"
MainGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
MainGui.Enabled = false
MainGui.DisplayOrder = 999999
MainGui.Parent = ParentContainer

local DashButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
DashButton.Name = "DashButton"
DashButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
DashButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
DashButton.Text = "SPIN DASH"
DashButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
DashButton.Parent = MainGui

local DashCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
DashCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

DashStroke.Thickness = 2
DashStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
DashStroke.Parent = DashButton

-- Mode Handler
local function applyMode(isPhone)
    if isPhone then
        DashButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 35)
        DashButton.TextSize = 12
        DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0.75, -17)
    else
        DashButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 48)
        DashButton.TextSize = 16
        DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -65, 0.75, -24)
    end
    SelectionGui:Destroy()
    MainGui.Enabled = true
end

PhoneBtn.Activated:Connect(function() applyMode(true) end)
TabletBtn.Activated:Connect(function() applyMode(false) end)

-- Mobile & PC Draggable Logic
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

DashButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = DashButton.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

DashButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- ========================================================
-- 3. SPIN DASH MECHANIC
-- ========================================================
local isDashing = false

local animR6 = Instance.new("Animation")
animR6.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://278828913"

local animR15 = Instance.new("Animation")
animR15.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://582855105"

local function performSpinDash()
    if isDashing then return end
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not root then return end
    
    isDashing = true
    
    -- Load Animation safely
    local animTrack
    pcall(function()
        local animToPlay = (humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6) and animR6 or animR15
        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
        animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animToPlay)
        animTrack:Play()
    end)
    
    -- Physics Setup
    local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    attachment.Parent = root
    
    local linearVel = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
    linearVel.Attachment0 = attachment
    linearVel.MaxForce = 999999
    linearVel.VectorVelocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * 60
    linearVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    linearVel.Parent = root
    
    local angularVel = Instance.new("AngularVelocity")
    angularVel.Attachment0 = attachment
    angularVel.MaxTorque = 999999
    angularVel.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 40, 0)
    angularVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    angularVel.Parent = root
    
    task.wait(0.5)
    
    linearVel:Destroy()
    angularVel:Destroy()
    attachment:Destroy()
    
    if animTrack then
        pcall(function()
            animTrack:Stop()
            animTrack:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    
    isDashing = false
end

DashButton.Activated:Connect(performSpinDash)

scripts.features: 👋👋Этот сценарий мой😎😎то что вы горите синим огнëм🔵🔵🔵ЭТО  FE👁‍🗨👁‍🗨
scripts.script:
-- Скрипт полёта с красивым синим огнём
-- Создаёт эффект синего пламени при полёте

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Настройки
local Settings = {
    FlySpeed = 50,
    ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.F,  -- Клавиша для включения/выключения
    FireSize = 5,
    FireColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255),
    FireTransparency = 0.3,
    TrailEnabled = true
}

-- Переменные
local isFlying = false
local flyConnection = nil
local fireEffects = {}
local trailEffect = nil

-- Функция создания огня
local function createFire(parent, position)
    local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
    fire.Size = Settings.FireSize
    fire.Color = Settings.FireColor
    fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200)
    fire.Heat = 15
    fire.Parent = parent
    
    return fire
end

-- Функция создания эффекта следа
local function createTrail()
    local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
    trail.Color = Color3.new(0, 0.6, 1)
    trail.Lifetime = 1
    trail.MinLength = 1
    trail.MaxLength = 10
    trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
    trail.Parent = rootPart
    return trail
end

-- Функция создания эффектов полёта
local function createFlyEffects()
    -- Огонь на ногах
    local leftFoot = character:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot")
    local rightFoot = character:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
    
    if leftFoot then
        local fire = createFire(leftFoot, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0))
        table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    end
    
    if rightFoot then
        local fire = createFire(rightFoot, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0))
        table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    end
    
    -- Огонь под персонажем
    local groundFire = Instance.new("Part")
    groundFire.Name = "FlyFirePart"
    groundFire.Size = Vector3.new(3, 0.5, 3)
    groundFire.Transparency = 0
    groundFire.CanCollide = false
    groundFire.Anchored = true
    groundFire.Parent = character
    
    local fire = createFire(groundFire, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
    table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    
    -- След
    if Settings.TrailEnabled then
        trailEffect = createTrail()
    end
end

-- Функция удаления эффектов
local function removeFlyEffects()
    for _, fire in ipairs(fireEffects) do
        if fire and fire.Parent then
            fire:Destroy()
        end
    end
    fireEffects = {}
    
    if trailEffect then
        trailEffect:Destroy()
        trailEffect = nil
    end
    
    local groundFire = character:FindFirstChild("FlyFirePart")
    if groundFire then
        groundFire:Destroy()
    end
end

-- Функция включения полёта
local function startFly()
    if isFlying then return end
    
    isFlying = true
    createFlyEffects()
    
    -- Включаем невесомость
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Falling, false)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)
    
    -- Управление полётом
    flyConnection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
        if not isFlying then return end
        
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local moveDirection = Vector3.new()
        
        -- Получаем ввод
        local keyboard = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        
        -- Нормализуем направление
        if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
            moveDirection = moveDirection.Unit * Settings.FlySpeed * deltaTime
            rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + moveDirection
        end
        
        -- Обновляем позицию огня
        local groundFire = character:FindFirstChild("FlyFirePart")
        if groundFire then
            groundFire.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0))
        end
        
        -- Анимация огня
        for _, fire in ipairs(fireEffects) do
            if fire and fire.Parent then
                fire.Size = Settings.FireSize + math.sin(tick() * 5) * 0.5
            end
        end
    end)
    
    -- Визуальный эффект запуска
    local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    particles.Name = "FlyParticles"
    particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(Settings.FireColor)
    particles.Size = NumberSequence.new(1, 3)
    particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
    particles.Rate = 50
    particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
    particles.Parent = rootPart
    
    -- Эффект свечения
    local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
    pointLight.Color = Settings.FireColor
    pointLight.Brightness = 5
    pointLight.Range = 15
    pointLight.Parent = rootPart
    pointLight.Name = "FlyLight"
    
    print("Полёт включён! Используйте WASD для движения, Space - вверх, Shift - вниз")
end

-- Функция выключения полёта
local function stopFly()
    if not isFlying then return end
    
    isFlying = false
    
    -- Отключаем невесомость
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Falling, true)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
    
    -- Удаляем эффекты
    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end
    
    removeFlyEffects()
    
    -- Удаляем частицы и свет
    local particles = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyParticles")
    if particles then
        particles:Destroy()
    end
    
    local light = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyLight")
    if light then
        light:Destroy()
    end
    
    print("Полёт выключен")
end

-- Переключение полёта
local function toggleFly()
    if isFlying then
        stopFly()
    else
        startFly()
    end
end

-- Обработка нажатия клавиши
game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Settings.ToggleKey then
        toggleFly()
    end
end)

-- GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FlyGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player.PlayerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.9, -50)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 40)
mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "✨ Полёт с Огнём ✨"
title.TextColor3 = Settings.FireColor
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 16
title.Parent = mainFrame

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.3, 0)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.Text = "Статус: Выключен"
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
statusLabel.TextSize = 14
statusLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30)
toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.6, 0)
toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200)
toggleButton.Text = "Включить (F)"
toggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggleButton.Parent = mainFrame

toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    toggleFly()
end)

-- Обновление статуса
spawn(function()
    while true do
        if isFlying then
            statusLabel.Text = "Статус: Включен"
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            toggleButton.Text = "Выключить (F)"
            toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
        else
            statusLabel.Text = "Статус: Выключен"
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
            toggleButton.Text = "Включить (F)"
            toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200)
        end
        wait(0.1)
    end
end)
